name: [STORAGE] Project Ghoul
desc:
[This game is in active development and being remade from scratch. Features and content may change or be removed during development. Join our community server for development updates, sneak peeks, and the latest codes.]

Become a Ghoul and hunt to survive, or join the CCG and protect humanity.

[Controls]
Left Mouse Button = Attack
F / Right Bumper = Block
E / Bottom DPad = Equip Quinque/Kagune
R / Right DPad = Kakuja
H / Left DPad = Arata Equip | Mask Equip
Ctrl / WW / Left Stick = Run
Q / Left Trigger = Dash
Skills = Z / Button X | X / Button Y | C / Button B [Go to "Menu" then "Controls."]

Weekend Boosts: +30% XP, Materials & Yen, plus discounted spins!
